motion.name: theme

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The form primary action. Solid Action Blue, white label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #007bff; color: #fff; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0056b3; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4d9fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #6c757d; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The outlined alternate on the homepage.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; background: #1b1e24; color: #4d9fff; border: 2px solid #4d9fff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem 2rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.1rem; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4d9fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A full-width field with the label above it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: #e2e8f0; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #626e7e; border-radius: 6px; background: #1b1e24; color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 1rem; font-family: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #4d9fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.1); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: The club bar. Current page is a raised step, not a blue link.
components.html: Omnium Volunteer HubShifts
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; background: #14171c; color: #e2e8f0; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #383f4a; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-nav-link { color: #e2e8f0; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.625rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { background: #252a32; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4d9fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shift Card
components.description: A shift on the board. Flat until the pointer can hover.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; background: #1b1e24; color: #e2e8f0; padding: 1.25rem; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #383f4a; text-decoration: none; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card span { color: #cbd5e0; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); } } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4d9fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a plain club tool. Dark is the default. Type is the system font. Shift Blue marks a link or an action, and status colors say whether something succeeded, needs attention, or failed. The page should read like a board of shifts, not a campaign.

Density sits between a form and a roster. The homepage has room for the headline and the shift cards. Admin and signup screens are closer together. Nothing here is a marketing site, and nothing here should grow a second visual language beside the board.

The kids' clinic page keeps its own cream, blue, and orange. That palette stays on that page.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default, with a light theme remembered in the browser.
One job color: Shift Blue for links and primary actions.
System type at a readable body size. Headings are the same family, heavier, tighter.
Surfaces are flat at rest. A border and a background step do the separating.
A shadow appears when someone points at a shift card or button, or when a menu overlays the page.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Shift Blue is the only action color on the hub. Success, warning, danger, and info are status. They do not become buttons.

rules.name: The Theme Token Rule
rules.body: New color uses the theme variables. Do not paste Action Blue into a new screen.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Do not add a second typeface for emphasis. Weight and size are the emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat Until You Point Rule
rules.body: A card at rest has no shadow. If a shadow is doing the job of a border, use the border.

dos: Do keep dark as the default and honor a stored light preference.
Do use the theme variables for new color, type, space, and radius.
Do leave cards flat, and add a shadow only for hover or an overlay.
Do keep one Shift Blue for links, focus, and the primary action.
Do put the focus ring on anything that can be reached from the keyboard.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, a gradient, or a marketing hero treatment.
Don't hardcode Action Blue, Action Blue Press, or Action Blue Deep in new UI.
Don't use status colors as button fills.
Don't let the kids' clinic cream, orange, or clinic blue into the hub.
Don't invent an 8px radius. Use the small, medium, or large step.
